description: This call retrieves applicable compatible vehicle property values based on the specified eBay marketplace, specified eBay category, and filters used in the request.

parameters.name: category_tree_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the category tree.

parameters.name: compatibility_property
parameters.description: One compatible vehicle property applicable (e.g. Trim).

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of an eBay category.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: One or more compatible vehicle property name/value pairs.
